tenures.note: Debuted on 11 June 2005 as younger sister Misaki Ishikawa's own new tag partner upon Reona Yoshida's own departure for Joshi Puroresu STARDOM, the pair billed together as the Psychommunity; won the UWF Women's Tag Team Championship match against the Love Sisters by pinfall (Misaki's own Death Valley Bomb on Lolita Love), hitting a satellite headscissors and an Asai moonsault of her own along the way. Won by forfeit over Sonya Benedict on 20 July 2005 after Benedict was taken into police custody; stablemates Misaki Ishikawa and Rocko applauded from ringside. Lost the Women's Tag Team Championship alongside Misaki Ishikawa to the Misfits by pinfall (a Spiked Mischief Maker) on 6 August 2005, Prophets of Rage member Shadoe Rage interfering to help finish her.

tenures.note: Appeared representing Project BATTLE*DREAM in a one-off interpromotional attraction match against UWF's own Fantasy Girl, carrying a taser to the ring (unused in the match) alongside sidekick Rocko; won by pinfall with the Skull Crash Buster. Teamed with countrywoman Reona Yoshida as the newly-billed Team BATTLE*DREAM in a four corners women's tag war on 25 August 2004, Yoshida's own double DDT setting up the pinfall on Melody for the win; earned a UWF Women's Tag Team Championship match against the Bod Squad the following week. Lost a UWF Women's Tag Team Championship challenge alongside Reona Yoshida to the champions, the Bod Squad, by disqualification on 8 September 2004, struck with a chair by Tara "Sunburst" Marshall to save the title. Teamed with Reona Yoshida and Sierra Browne to beat Donna Tetreault and the Bod Squad in a non-title six-woman tag on 2 October 2004, tasering Tara "Sunburst" Marshall mid-match before Sierra Browne's own Truth Superkick finished Brianna Landis for the pin. Lost a UWF Women's Heavyweight Championship of the World challenge to champion Donna Tetreault by disqualification on 16 October 2004 after being found with a taser at ringside, despite having Tetreault beaten clean with the Skull Crash Buster moments earlier. Knocked out at ringside by Tara "Sunburst" Marshall with the Bod Squad's own championship belt on 1 December 2004 during tag partner Reona Yoshida's own loss to Brianna Landis; Marshall then used Ishikawa's own taser on a bystander identified only as Rocko.
